subject.title: Fix live orphan session transcript visibility

question: Should owner-qualified live transcript hits with no combined-store entry be readable by synthesizing `agent:<owner>:<stem>` when the owner matches the scoped/requesting agent?
rationale: The code path is narrow and tested, but it intentionally converts one missing-metadata session-history case from fail-closed to allowed, which is a maintainer privacy and session-state boundary decision.

options.title: Accept scoped fallback
options.body: Merge this approach after maintainer review because it restores same-agent live orphan visibility while preserving cross-agent fail-closed behavior in tests.

options.title: Require fuller runtime replay
options.body: Ask for a live Gateway/index refresh proof before merge if terminal smoke plus targeted tests are not enough for this boundary.

options.title: Defer to identity mapping
options.body: Keep the PR open or close it in favor of a broader session identity mapping design if synthetic live keys are not an acceptable steady-state fallback.

recommendation.title: Accept scoped fallback
recommendation.body: Merge this approach after maintainer review because it restores same-agent live orphan visibility while preserving cross-agent fail-closed behavior in tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They carried the recent merged session identity mapping work that this fallback must remain compatible with.
